title: 第十五章 分钱识人心第十六章 唐朝大兄
lines: 福运楼，酒博士走马灯似的在门廊内外穿梭，上酒上菜，菜主要是煮羊肉佐以胡椒，青菜佐以盐巴，豕肉切块佐以辣子，主食则是胡饼，馎饦。
大唐的菜式实在是单调，在这个没有炒菜火锅，佐料稀缺的时代，岳峰这个吃货着实难以大快朵颐。
好在今天赴宴的人大家心情都棒，绿蚁酒虽然又淡又酸，但是大碗喝起来也聊胜于无。
酒过三巡，菜过五味，岳峰咳嗽了一声，道：“各位，这一次蹴鞠我们大获全胜！我早说三班衙役就是银样镴枪头，不值得怕，只要我们认真团结，他们必将被我们打败，现在我们成功了！”
所有人都齐齐站起身来，强子道：“这都是岳首领手段高，我等皆心服口服！”
“我等皆心服口服！”其他的人都齐声道。
强子时隔多年，重新回到了县衙，虽然只是干小吏，但是比他杀猪有面子多了，而且他的几个兄弟也都成了县衙的吏，以后皆衣食无忧，他对岳峰尤其感恩。
朱恩几次经历生死，现在能从不良人干到吏员，能够有一份稳定的收入，他也十分知足。
还有鲁小山，昨天他回到家里之后，把街坊邻居全都叫了过去，着实让孙二愣狠狠的丢了面子，以前孙二愣怎么欺负他们兄弟的，鲁小山昨天便怎么让孙二愣难堪的，经过了昨天的事情，以后他们兄弟再也不会被孙二愣欺负了。
大家的兴致都极高，岳峰清了清嗓子道：“这一次我们大胜，县尊大人高兴，赏钱一百贯！这些钱兄弟们都有份，现在我说一下分配方案，大家看看有什么疑问！”
强子脱口道：“首领，县尊大人这些钱是赏给您的！我们岂能要？我们跟着您要到了前程，这钱的事情便不能再提了！”
鲁小山和朱恩齐齐附和，道：“不错！这钱是您的，我们不能要！”
岳峰微微一笑，环顾四周，将大家的表情都尽收眼底，这才道：“钱财是身外之物，咱们兄弟既然出了力，那就不能没有表示，你们都听好了！
这一百贯钱，鲁小山、朱恩和强子，三人一人八贯。方氏兄弟一人八贯，其余的人一人五贯，一共分七十贯给你们，剩下的钱和绢归我，如何？”
一屋子人个个都收声不说话，鲁小山率先道：“首领，您自己分得太少了！我们这么多人联合起来也比不上您一人的功劳！”
岳峰摆摆手道：“我得三十贯，还有十匹绢价值五贯钱，其实不少了！”
岳峰这么说，鲁小山等也不好再坚持，又过了一会儿，强子手底下的三皮躲躲闪闪的道：“首领，强哥和小山哥还有朱恩哥分八贯我觉得可以，可是方氏兄弟为何也能比我们多三贯钱？”
强子冷笑一声，道：“三皮，你他妈是被猪油蒙了心了吧？方氏兄弟被燕二使钱拉拢，如果不是他们兄弟仗义，这时候我们还能在这里喝酒行乐？估摸着大家都被姓魏的下到大牢里面，皮鞭子伺候了！”
朱恩在一旁道：“不错，方氏兄弟是大功臣，首领给他们奖励没有问题！”
三皮讪笑低头，其他人也都不敢说什么了，岳峰道：“好了，既然定下来了，钱就分下去了。兄弟们继续喝酒，今天大家不醉不归啊！”
岳峰说罢，冲着大家拱手，酒桌的气氛又恢复了之前的热闹。喝得微醺醉意了，岳峰瞅着大家都兴致不减，他便独自出了门，一个人回到了县衙的居所。
傅游艺的廨舍里面没有人，这糟老头子是投机钻营的老手，攀上了姚县令之后，立刻便鼓动如簧之舌，陪着姚云生去了东都，估计是去活动姚云生背后的关系去了！
当然，傅游艺走之前和岳峰进行了一次很动情的深谈，声称此次去东都是要给岳峰求得一个机会，岳峰本事很高，相信如果能得贵人举荐，必然能谋得一官半职。
岳峰对傅游艺这番言论自然不会太当真，但是如果真如傅游艺所说，岳峰能够谋到一份官职，那也算是被天上掉馅饼给砸中了。
因为历史上唐宋时期的官员俸禄是非常高的，就算是从九品的小官职，收入也相当的不菲。
就以九品下的散官“将仕郎”的俸禄来举例，唐朝官员的俸禄分为三部分，分别是“禄米”、“月俸”还有“力课”。
将仕郎一年领禄米五十石，月奉按月发放，一月差不多有两贯钱，一年能收入二十贯。最后“力课”，唐朝规定，从九品官政府免费提供两个劳动力干活，这个价值折算成钱一年也差不多值四五贯。
这三样是俸禄，除了俸禄之外还有福利，那就是当官的朝廷会分田，从九品官朝廷分职田两百亩，两百亩田收的租差不多能有七十石。
所以，一个最低级的大唐官员，一年的收入可以折合成一百二十石米，外加二十四五贯钱。
这样的收入一眼看上去，就足够一家人锦衣玉食，过得十分体面了。所以大唐的官员绝对是最有前途的职业。
只是现在这个世道，当官的确风险极大，岳峰实在不敢乐观，所以他的内心颇为矛盾。
“是谁啊?”岳峰眉头一挑，倏然看向门口，门口探出一个头来，赫然是朱恩。
“岳大哥，您……您是不是有心事，我观您似乎有些不高兴！心中不放心，便过来看一看！”朱恩道。
岳峰淡淡一笑，摇了摇头道：“你别多想，和兄弟们没有关系，只是我想到了一些人和事而已。”
朱恩咽了咽唾沫道：“大哥，我知道您非常人！今天我们这一帮兄弟一起把酒言欢，您把自己得的赏分给我们，所谓财帛见人心，我从旁观看，也大抵看出我们这十一个兄弟，并非真的一条心！
强子那边，三皮、杠头这两人便不地道，原六房的书吏中，周梁似乎也有二心。这几个东西，都忘了这些钱是怎么来的呢！这等货色，大哥您要小心用啊……”
岳峰盯着朱恩道：“你小子想说什么？别吞吞吐吐！”
朱恩凑到岳峰近前道：“这一次主薄大人和县尊去了东都，凭县尊的身份，定然能给您要一个官职回来。而今咱们合宫县正处在变革的时候，魏生明虽然被县尊压下来了，可是其爪牙仍在，此人必然不会就此善罢甘休。
咱们这帮兄弟都是大哥您带出来的，以后大家肯定死心塌地的跟着你，将来势必有硬岔子要碰！蹴鞠游戏尔，博贵人一笑而已，蹴鞠之外，那可就是你死我活了，关键时候，用人失察，恐怕会堕入万劫不复之境呢！”
岳峰哈哈大笑，用手指着朱恩道：“你这小子，还真有狗头军师的潜力啊，行，以后我就封你为狗头军师！”
朱恩讪讪的笑了笑，气氛顿时变得轻松……
content_en:
In Fuyun Building, Dr. Jiu walked in and out of the porch like a revolving door, serving wine and dishes. The main dishes were boiled mutton with pepper, green vegetables with salt, hog meat cut into cubes with chili pepper, and the staple food was pancakes and steamed buns.
The dishes of the Tang Dynasty are really monotonous. In this era when there are no hot pots and seasonings are scarce, it is really difficult for Yue Feng, a foodie, to enjoy the food.
Fortunately, everyone at the banquet today was in a good mood. Although the green ant wine was light and sour, drinking it from a large bowl was better than nothing.
After three rounds of wine and five flavors of food, Yue Feng coughed and said: "Everyone, we have won a great victory in Cuju this time! I have long said that the third class of government officials are like silver pewter spearheads and are not worth fearing. As long as we unite seriously, they will be defeated by us. Now we have succeeded!"
Everyone stood up together, and Qiangzi said: "This is because Chief Yue is so clever, and we are all convinced!"
"We are all convinced!" Everyone else said in unison.
After many years, Qiangzi returned to the county government. Although he was only a small official, he was more respectable than killing pigs. Moreover, several of his brothers also became officials of the county government, and they all had no worries about food and clothing. He was especially grateful to Yue Feng.
Zhu En has experienced life and death several times, and now he can work from a bad person to an official, and he is very satisfied with being able to have a stable income.
And Lu Xiaoshan, after he returned home yesterday, he called all the neighbors over, which really made Sun Er Leng lose face. How did Sun Er Leng bully their brother before? How did Lu Xiaoshan embarrass Sun Er Leng yesterday? After what happened yesterday, their brothers will never be bullied by Sun Er Leng again.
Everyone was in high spirits. Yue Feng cleared his throat and said, "This time we won a big victory. The county magistrate is very happy and will give us a reward of one hundred guan! All the brothers have a share of the money. Now let me tell you about the distribution plan. Let's see if you have any questions!"
Qiangzi blurted out: "Chief, this money is rewarded to you by the county magistrate! How can we take it? We will follow you to get a future, and we can't mention this money anymore!"
Lu Xiaoshan and Zhu En both agreed, "That's right! This money is yours, we can't take it!"
Yue Feng smiled slightly, looked around, took in everyone's expressions, and then said: "Money is something external to the body. Since our brothers have contributed, we have to express it. You all listen up!
For this one hundred guan, Lu Xiaoshan, Zhu En and Qiangzi each had eight guan. Each of the Fang brothers has eight guans, and each of the others has five guans. A total of seventy guan will be given to you. The remaining money and silk will be mine. How about that? "
Everyone in the room was silent. Lu Xiaoshan was the first to say: "Chief, you yourself have received too little! Even if all of us join together, we can't compare to your contribution!"
Yue Feng waved his hand and said: "I have thirty guans, and I also have ten pieces of silk worth five guans, which is actually quite a lot!"
Yue Feng said this, and Lu Xiaoshan couldn't hold on any longer. After a while, Sanpi under Qiangzi's hand said evasively: "Chief, I think it's okay for Brother Qiang, Brother Xiaoshan and Brother Zhu En to divide eight guans, but why can the Fang brothers have three more guans than us?"
Qiangzi sneered and said: "Sanpi, are you fucking fooled by lard? The Fang brothers were lured in by Yan Er's money. If it weren't for their brothers' righteousness, would we still be here drinking and having fun at this time? I guess everyone was sent to the prison by Wei and served with leather whips!"
Zhu En said from the side: "Yes, the Fang brothers are great heroes, there is no problem for the leader to reward them!"
Sanpi smiled and lowered his head, and the others did not dare to say anything. Yue Feng said: "Okay, now that it's settled, the money will be divided. Brothers, keep drinking. We won't go home until we are drunk today!"
After Yue Feng finished speaking, he bowed his hands to everyone, and the atmosphere at the wine table returned to its previous liveliness. After being slightly drunk, Yue Feng saw that everyone was still in high spirits, so he went out alone and returned to the county government residence alone.
There was no one in Fu Youyi's house. This bad old man was a veteran in speculative business. After he got in touch with Yao County Magistrate, he immediately followed Yao Yunsheng to Dongdu with his eloquent tongue. He probably went to try to establish the connections behind Yao Yunsheng!
Of course, Fu Youyi had a very emotional and in-depth talk with Yue Feng before leaving, claiming that this trip to the East was all about giving Yue Feng a chance. Yue Feng was very capable and believed that if he could be recommended by a noble person, he would definitely be able to get an official position.
Naturally, Yue Feng would not take Fu Youyi's remarks too seriously, but if it was true as Fu Youyi said, Yue Feng would be lucky enough to get an official position.
Because historically the salaries of officials during the Tang and Song dynasties were very high, even from a minor official position of ninth rank, the income was quite high.
Take the salary of "General Shilang", a casual official of the ninth rank, as an example. The salary of officials in the Tang Dynasty was divided into three parts, namely "lumi", "monthly salary" and "like".
The generals and ministers received 50 shi of lumi a year, and the monthly salary was paid out on a monthly basis. They had almost two guan of money in a month, and they could earn 20 guan in a year. The last "force lesson", the Tang Dynasty stipulated that the government of the ninth rank official should provide two laborers for free to work. This value is equivalent to about four or five guans per year when converted into money.
These three are salaries. In addition to salary, there are benefits. That is, the court will allocate land to officials. From the ninth-grade official, the court will allocate 200 acres of land. The rent collected from the 200 acres of land can be almost 70 shi.
Therefore, the income of the lowest-level Tang Dynasty official can be converted into one hundred and twenty shi meters per year, plus twenty-four or five guan of money.
At first glance, this kind of income is enough for the family to live a decent life. Therefore, being an official in the Tang Dynasty is definitely the most promising career.
It's just that in today's world, being an official is indeed extremely risky. Yue Feng really doesn't dare to be optimistic, so he is quite conflicted in his heart.
"Who is it?" Yue Feng raised his eyebrows and suddenly looked at the door. A head popped out of the door, and it was Zhu En.
"Brother Yue, are you...do you have something on your mind? I think you seem a little unhappy! You were worried, so I came over to take a look!" Zhu En said.
Yue Feng smiled faintly, shook his head and said: "Don't think too much, it has nothing to do with the brothers, it's just that I thought of some people and things."
Zhu En swallowed his saliva and said: "Brother, I know you are very human! Today we, a group of brothers, are drinking and chatting together, and you will share your rewards with us. It is said that money reflects people's hearts. I watched from the sidelines and I can tell that we, the eleven brothers, are not really of the same mind!
On Qiangzi's side, Sanpi and Gangtou were not honest. Among the former scribes in the sixth room, Zhou Liang seemed to have second thoughts. For these things, I have forgotten where the money came from! Brother, you have to be careful with this kind of stuff..."
Yue Feng stared at Zhu En and said, "What do you want to say? Don't hesitate!"
Zhu En came closer to Yue Feng and said: "This time Lord Bo and the county magistrate have gone to the Eastern Capital. With the status of the county magistrate, I will definitely be able to get you an official position. Now Hegong County is in a period of change. Although Wei Shengming has been suppressed by the county magistrate, his minions are still there, and this person will definitely not give up.
Our group of brothers were all brought out by you, big brother. From now on, everyone will follow you wholeheartedly. There will definitely be hard problems to encounter in the future! The game of Cuju is just a smile for Bogui. Outside of Cuju, it’s a matter of life and death. At the critical moment, if the employer is careless, he may fall into a situation of eternal disaster! "
Yue Feng laughed loudly, pointed at Zhu En and said, "You boy, you really have the potential of a dog-headed military advisor. Okay, I will make you a dog-headed military advisor from now on!"
Zhu En smiled coquettishly, and the atmosphere suddenly became relaxed...
title_en: Chapter 15: Spend money to understand people's hearts Chapter 16: The eldest brother of the Tang Dynasty
